metadata.description: Baseline structural data for all Currier B token types

chedy.workshop_reading: Check the state — active verification that cooling/stabilization is proceeding
chedy.notes: The workhorse checkpoint token. "Actively verify the current cooling state."

ol.workshop_reading: Hold steady — maintain current arrangement without change
evidence: C1388: o+l = arrange+state = STAGING, 100% STAGING per C1556
ol.notes: The continuation/sustain token. Most common operational word. "Keep going as you are."

shedy.workshop_reading: Watch the state — passive observation of cooling/stabilization process
shedy.notes: The workhorse monitoring token. "Observe without intervening."

aiin.workshop_reading: Yield product into the next processing cycle
aiin.notes: Iteration with yield. "The output from this step feeds into the next cycle."

daiin.operational_def: Begin iteration cycle / trigger energy sequence
daiin.workshop_reading: Start a new cycle — initiate the next heating-monitoring loop
daiin.notes: The cycle trigger. Signals "begin the next iteration of the process."

qokeedy.workshop_reading: Heat source: gentle heat in water bath, execute, done
evidence: f108v: e_depth=0.99, pure balneum folio dominated by this token
qokeedy.notes: Gentle balneum heat. "Maintain steady gentle heat in the water bath."

qokain.workshop_reading: Heat source: apply heat and iterate — sustained cyclic heating
evidence: The iterative heat token. Appears during sustained/repeated heating phases.
qokain.notes: Cyclic heat application. "Continue heating through another cycle."

qokedy.workshop_reading: Heat source: apply standard heat, cool, execute, done
qokedy.notes: Standard heat application. Not gentle (that is qokeedy) but not aggressive.

qokeey.workshop_reading: Heat source: establish gentle heat state
qokeey.notes: Heat level setting, not execution. "Set the heat to gentle/balneum level."

or.operational_def: Respond to current state / flow routing
or.workshop_reading: Note what happened — acknowledge and route to next action
or.notes: Line-boundary flow marker. "This step responds to what just happened."

ar.workshop_reading: Note the yield — observe what was produced

qokaiin.workshop_reading: Heat source: sustained deep cyclic heating — multiple iterations
evidence: Deeper iteration than qokain. Extended heating sequences.
qokaiin.notes: Extended cyclic heating. "Continue sustained heat through multiple cycles."

evidence: Shorter/lighter version of shedy (no d=execute component)
shey.notes: Quick look. "Briefly observe the current state."

dar.workshop_reading: Add a new substance — vigorous material introduction event
evidence: dar count tracks material events precisely
dar.notes: The material introduction marker. Each dar = one physical addition event.

al.workshop_reading: The product is at rest — yield has reached stable state
al.notes: Output state. "The yield is now in a stable state."

okaiin.operational_def: Deep vessel cycling / extended sealed operation
okaiin.workshop_reading: Vessel management: extended sealed processing through multiple cycles
okaiin.notes: Extended sealed vessel operation. "Maintain sealed vessel through many cycles."

qokal.workshop_reading: Heat source: bring heat to yield state — heat until stable
evidence: f75r: appears at distillation pass endpoints
qokal.notes: Heat completion marker. "Heat until the process reaches steady state."

otedy.operational_def: Monitor transfer rate: cool and execute
otedy.workshop_reading: Transfer rate: check the drip/flow rate during cooling
evidence: C1958: ot = transfer rate / drip rate
otedy.notes: Transfer monitoring. "Check the drip rate during this cooling step."

qol.workshop_reading: Heat source: hold current heat level
qol.notes: Heat hold. "Keep the fire at its current level."

qokar.workshop_reading: Heat source: apply heat and note the response
qokar.notes: Responsive heating. "Heat and observe what the material does."

okain.workshop_reading: Vessel management: seal the vessel for a processing cycle
evidence: Appears at moments of sealing in f84r, f82r
okain.notes: Vessel sealing. "Seal the vessel for the next processing cycle."

dal.operational_def: Careful passive placement or transfer of material
dal.workshop_reading: Place material carefully — gentle/measured transfer or output
evidence: dal=6 on f77v (furnace spec, careful arrangement)
dal.notes: Passive counterpart to dar. Careful placement vs vigorous addition.
